layout.deniedBody: Your account isn’t an admin, so you can’t open the admin console.

runRecords.sub: Errors the platform hit across projects and what it handled itself, kept for 30 days

machines.sub: The platform's MicroCloud hosts, the sandboxes on each, and the warm pool; refreshed every 30 seconds

kpi.slotsNote: {free} free; the pool keeps at least {min} and adds a host below that
kpi.failuresNote: Hosts the provider broke in the last {minutes} minutes; at {limit} the platform stops opening machines and tries one every {probe} minutes
kpi.hostsNote: Whole VMs count toward the cap; given-up and releasing hosts do not.
kpi.warm: Warm machines are counted separately: {n} now, target {target}.

alert.notConfigured: This deployment has no MicroCloud configured; cloud sandboxes are unavailable
alert.refusing: Not starting new AI teammates now: the provider broke {n} hosts recently (last at {at}), and the platform waits for a probe to succeed
alert.atCap: The pool is at its cap of {max} hosts: with no free slot, AI teammates that try to start are refused

note.failed: Broken by the provider, given up at {at}; waiting for the provider to delete it
note.releasing: Released at {at}; waiting for the provider to delete it
note.draining: Rolling rebuild started {for} ago; released and replaced once empty

when.overdue: past its idle time and not reclaimed yet (the room's AI teammate stopping later, or a background command still running, pushes it back)

fact.refused: AI teammate starts refused (pool full / provider failing)
fact.hostsLost: Hosts given up (provider error · offline · never enrolled)
fact.sandboxesLost: Working sandboxes lost with their host

machines.config: Each host takes the smaller of {perCore} sandboxes per core and as many as fit in its memory at {memory} GB each; a sandbox is destroyed after {sandboxIdle} idle, a host released after {hostIdle} idle, a whole VM after {vmIdle} idle

usage.label: Usage of {host}
usage.history: lines show the last {span}, peak per step
usage.pressure: Memory pressure (1 min / 5 min): some {some}, full {full}
usage.foot: Usage, each sandbox's disk among it, is read every {check}. A host past {disk} disk, {inodes} inodes or {memory} memory on two readings running is sent to the alert group; a sandbox at {near} of a limit is highlighted.

machines.fixedFoot: The fixed pool keeps {n} ordinary hosts up; one whose enrollment script, template or size changed is replaced, and so is one older than {days} days — one at a time: it takes no new sandbox, then is released and replaced once empty.
machines.fixedFootNoAge: The fixed pool keeps {n} ordinary hosts up; one whose enrollment script, template or size changed is replaced — one at a time: it takes no new sandbox, then is released and replaced once empty.
